item.title: Wanderers power to fifth straight Young Motors T20 Women’s cricket title against Sporties
item.description: Wanderers have claimed their fifth successive Young Motors Women’s T20 cricket title with a resounding seven-wicket win over Sporties at Wonthella on Saturday night.

item.title: Geraldton water polo: B52’s bag A-grade men’s three-peat in thrilling grand final decided by penalty shootout
item.description: B52’s completed a clean sweep of all men’s grades at the Geraldton Waterpolo Association grand finals on Saturday, with the men’s top side edging Demons in a match that went down to the wire at Aquarena.

item.title: Geraldton water polo: B52’s A-grade women seal sixth straight title, Serpents snap 13-year drought
item.description: B52’s produced a stunning comeback to claim the women’s A-grade shield at the Aquarena on Saturday, overturning a four-goal deficit to defeat Demons 12-11 and secure their sixth consecutive championship.

item.title: Housing costs and rising price of food put strain on Geraldton residents and businesses
item.description: Cost of living continues to bite in Geraldton, with more residents seeking help from support services than ever and businesses feeling the pinch.

item.title: Geraldton Buccaneers take next steps in women’s team revival, taking applications for interim head coach
item.description: Geraldton Buccaneers have taken the next step in re-establishing its women’s side and are taking applications for an interim coach to develop local women’s talent.

item.title: Snapshot in Time: The key role the old Post Office and Telephone Exchange played in Mullewa’s history
item.description: The old Post Office and Telephone Exchange at Mullewa played an integral role in the community.

item.title: Volunteer fireys in Mid West given funding to pay for essential equipment and training
item.description: Volunteer firefighters in the shires of Northampton and Dandaragan will be receiving financial support from the State Government and Western Power in a new round of funding announced last week.

item.title: Fisheries inquiry e-petition due to be tabled in WA Parliament on same day as scheduled rally
item.description: A petition which originated in Geraldton calling for an inquiry into WA’s fisheries management will be tabled in WA Parliament on Thursday, as the Nationals WA hold a rally.

item.title: Meru Waste Management Facility takes a green turn as LMS Energy starts work to reduce methane gas
item.description: Waste disposal in Geraldton has just turned a lot greener, with the City of Greater Geraldton starting work to begin gas flaring at Meru Waste Management Facility.

item.title: Tremayne B James Garlett: Geraldton man, 33, jailed for 13 months over ‘outrageous’ police pursuit
item.description: A 33-year-old man has been jailed and banned from driving for life following a police pursuit in Geraldton earlier this month.
